# FLX-6108: a window whose value depends on ties has an order that is not total

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

ROW_NUMBER, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, LAG and LEAD depend on how tied rows are ordered. Their ORDER BY keys, with the partitioning relationship's columns, must name every key column the expose declares, so that no two rows tie. Add the missing key columns to the end of ORDER BY. RANK and DENSE_RANK take any order.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6108
```
